Sam W: Quick sync — Payments V2 threat model + privacy compliance briefing :calendar: Need to book 60m next week. Attendees: Eng leads, Sec, Privacy, Legal (as needed). Preferred: Wed/Thu morning PST. Any blockers?

Maria K: Wed 10:00am PST works for me. Can we include CI/Infra (Dave) and product PM? :+1:

Raj P: Thu morning is tight for me. If Wed 10 works for infra, I'm good.

Tina L: I can do Wed 10 as well. Suggest adding a short runbook review for data flows.

Emily N: I can join Wed 10. I'll bring threat model draft and a quick sequence diagram.

Sam W: Great — sounds like Wed 10am PST is the frontrunner. Quick poll:
• Wed 10:00am PST — ✅
• Wed 11:30am PST —
• Thu 9:00am PST —

Please react with ✅ to confirm or reply if you can't.

security-bot: Provisional event created: Payments V2 — Threat/Privacy Briefing · Wed 10:00am PT · 60m. Calendar invites queued to attendees.

Maria K: Can we lock agenda now? Proposed:
```
1) 5m — Goals and scope (Sam)
2) 15m — Threat model walkthrough (Emily)
3) 15m — Data access & privacy controls (Tina / Privacy)
4) 10m — Infra/CI implications + hosting (Raj / Dave)
5) 10m — Action items & owners (Sam)
```

Raj P: Add a 5m check for audit evidence we need to capture.

Tina L: Also request that Legal reviews the data retention section pre-meeting. @Maria K can you ping Legal?

Maria K: Yep, I'll loop in Legal and ask for a short look-by Tuesday COB.

sre-oncall: FYI — if we discuss rotation keys/KMS, please include the SRE oncall or leave a doc link.

Sam W: Good call. I'll post the threat model doc + sequence diagram and a quick checklist for audit evidence. Pre-reads by EOD Monday: link: https://redwood-internal/papers/payments-v2/threat-model

Emily N: I'll upload the threat model v0.3 and mark sections that need feedback.

Tina L: If anyone can't make Wed 10, reply here and we can do a 1:1 follow-up. Otherwise I will draft the meeting notes template after pre-reads land.

Sam W: Thanks all — locking Wed 10am PST. Agenda and pre-reads will be in the event. See you there :eyes:
